consequence.statement: The update-success metric is now exported as `envoy_cilium_npds_update_success` instead of `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_success`, so queries using the old name need to be reviewed.
consequence.remediation: Update any dashboards, alerts or recording rules that use `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_success` to use `envoy_cilium_npds_update_success`.

original.statement: In Cilium 1.17 the metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_success` is renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_update_success`.

decision.reason: [ev-0739bc6582ad] lists this metric under "Changed Metrics" as a straight rename, and [ev-77f05428497a] says the prefix of all Envoy NPDS metrics changed from `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_` to `envoy_cilium_npds_`. The metric is still exported, only under a new name. The evidence doesn't say anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured, so a mandatory-work kind would over-claim. behavior-change with review-required, low severity and a remediation to update dashboards and alerts is the reading the evidence supports.
